name: Chassepot
source:
"Bonjour, Master. I'm Chassepot. I'm a bolt-action rifle born in France. The white polish gives me a French elegance, don't you think?

...First of all, I want to make one thing clear: please don't lump me together with others of the same era, okay? I have a much longer effective range than Dreyse or the like, and I'm far, far superior in performance.

...Well, if we're talking performance, my younger brother Grasse is better, but... He lacks elegance and nobility, and he doesn't understand the weight of history, so I don't feel like I'd lose to him as a Gun Knight.
I'm sure I'll be more useful to you than he is... so if you're going to rely on someone, I'd be happy if you chose me.
Looking forward to working with you, Master ♡"
